assumptions: P&ID note states 'no drawing: take equipment and connections from data sheet' - topology is single tower PV-1767 with feed, overhead partial condenser (vent + reflux/ethylene), bottom reboiler; no other equipment modelled.
Data sheet contradictory P&ID attributes: none (no P&ID drawing to compare) - site data used verbatim; listed as assumption per instructions.

Tower stages: CET69 Fig 2 shows ~154 trays + condenser + reboiler =156 stages used; feed above tray 37 from bottom modelled as feed_stage=118 (counting reboiler as stage 156 from top condenser=1). Side reboiler duty folded into main reboiler (paper states side reboiler contributed ~15% but not metered separately).

Pasteurization section (chimney trays 1-10 for ethylene pasteurization) lumped: ethylene chimney product modelled as primary liquid distillate (ETHYLENE) and lights as partial condenser vapour product (VENT) to allow single rigorous column. Mass balance closure with 99.94% purity validated; large vapour side-draw not converged in DWSIM - lumped approach stated as assumption.

Utilities as feeds utility:true not needed: highly heat-integrated tower - condenser cooled by integrated propylene refrigeration and reboiler heated by process (not modelled once-through) - duties reported only; no separate chilled water loop.

Tray capacity factor 1.30 is a calibration multiplier on Fair sieve-tray flood correlation to reproduce quoted 87% flood for existing 4-pass conventional trays (paper rating ~87%); flood limit 0.85 (85%) applied with tcf=1.30 gives utilisation 0.996 at base rate.
Feed T -9.5 C assumed vapour fraction 1.0 (deethanizer overhead vapour) - P=25.5 bar feed pressure chosen to give vapour at -9.5 C (paper quotes 25.5 barg feed); small superheat validated.
Component slate truncated to 6 key: N2, CH4, C2=, C2, C3=, iC4 - H2 omitted after test (4.3e-05 mole negligible, caused solver mass-balance error at trace level) and heavier C4+ lumped to iC4.
Murphree efficiency 0.78 applied uniformly to match required reflux 6.08 for polymer-grade purity with 154 trays (conventional trays lower efficiency due to 4-pass maldistribution).

energy.note: An overall energy balance is not closed: the simulator's streams do not report enthalpy. Unit duties are checked one by one instead.
